name: Adding and removing items updates the cart badge
fullName: SauceDemo.UiTests/Features/Cart/Adding and removing items updates the cart badge

steps.name: Given I log in with my assigned user
When I add "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
When I add "Sauce Labs Bike Light" to the cart
Then the cart badge should show 2
When I remove "Sauce Labs Backpack" from the cart
Then the cart badge should show 1
